insight: Y Combinator–backed; raised a $2.8M seed round to build an AI-native document editor for writers.
name: Type
tagline: The AI-native document editor for long-form writing.
description: Type is a web-based document editor with AI woven directly into the writing surface, letting you summon writing commands and an iterative chat without leaving the page. It targets long-form work — books, screenplays, and stories — with character, scene, and world-building tools and drafts up to 150,000 words. A free perpetual tier covers drafts, with paid plans for power users.

modelSupport.notes: Writing commands and chat run on state-of-the-art LLMs.

edge: A full long-form editor built for book-length drafts up to 150,000 words, not just an inline AI prompt bolted onto a notes app.
pros: Export to DOCX, PDF, or AI audio
cons: Web-only — no desktop or mobile apps
Skews to fiction over business docs
